title: VMS Mathematical Bridge to SymPy Audit: claim-to-code traceability

method.classification: Human-guided claim interpretation cross-checked with AST and complete 32-file source inspection
method.confidence: Bounded to specified original Math Appendix claims and the named SymPy ZIP, not all VMS publications or unpublished tests
method.meaning_of_matched: A module tests a mathematical object or law analogous/related to a source claim; it does not alone prove emergence from the primitive VMS postulates.
method.meaning_of_unverified: The declared VMS-specific derivational step was not implemented as a tested proposition in this ZIP. It may appear elsewhere in publications.

claims.title: Primitives and objects
claims.verified_piece: F0000 checks geometric scaling identities; F0005 constructs an antisymmetric tensor from a potential; F0014 checks an assumed loop-mass functional.
claims.unverified_vms_specific_step: No module establishes a physically propagating void surface or obtains the VMS transport one-form and its action from A1–A3.
claims.interpretation: The related blocks cannot establish the full source claim solely by passing.

claims.title: Conservation premises
claims.verified_piece: F0005 checks component identities of a potential-generated two-form, F0007 derives wave equations from vacuum Maxwell equations, and F0024 checks conventional charge continuity.
claims.unverified_vms_specific_step: The inference that finite space tension A3 supplies d⋆K=0, rather than this being an independently specified field equation, has no dedicated proof obligation.
claims.interpretation: The related blocks cannot establish the full source claim solely by passing.

claims.title: Wave equation and gauge
claims.verified_piece: F0007 tests curl-based vacuum wave equations after accepting Maxwell's vacuum equations; F0005 verifies field-tensor properties.
claims.unverified_vms_specific_step: No code checks the claimed caustic-axis constraint, the gauge choice required for the proposed void transport, or the full asserted equivalence under VMS geometry.
claims.interpretation: The related blocks cannot establish the full source claim solely by passing.

claims.title: Variational transport
claims.verified_piece: F0005 symbolically examines the standard gauge-potential field tensor and action-variation algebra.
claims.unverified_vms_specific_step: No module starts with the author's void boundary and derives the particular VMS transport action and its surface-action-density normalization.
claims.interpretation: The related blocks cannot establish the full source claim solely by passing.

claims.title: Null waves and polarization
claims.verified_piece: F0007 concerns Maxwell vacuum waves; F0013 checks consequences of a specified loop quantization condition.
claims.unverified_vms_specific_step: No direct test of the fold-caustic Airy construction, claimed polarization selection by its normal, or caustic-derived count of modes.
claims.interpretation: The related blocks cannot establish the full source claim solely by passing.

claims.title: Energy transport
claims.verified_piece: F0002 obtains radial 1/r² gravity scaling from an assumed Poisson problem; F0015 and F0025 test the conventional electromagnetic Poynting theorem.
claims.unverified_vms_specific_step: None of these tests implements the specific proposed VMS transport-current expression or the stated current-conservation inference from its vacuum transport equations.
claims.interpretation: The related blocks cannot establish the full source claim solely by passing.

claims.title: Broken closure and sources
claims.verified_piece: F0005 verifies source-coupled Maxwell action components; F0023 examines Ampère–Maxwell; F0024 checks conventional charge continuity.
claims.unverified_vms_specific_step: No code demonstrates that imperfect void closure generates the particular three-form source J appearing in the VMS appendix.
claims.interpretation: The related blocks cannot establish the full source claim solely by passing.

claims.title: Source action and flux
claims.verified_piece: F0005 treats a standard field action with source terms; F0021 checks Gauss's law, and F0024 checks the usual continuity identity.
claims.unverified_vms_specific_step: No direct executable check of the appendix's differential-form source action, its complete gauge variation, and the stated three-form flux relationship.
claims.interpretation: The related blocks cannot establish the full source claim solely by passing.

claims.title: Source energy balance
claims.verified_piece: F0015 and F0025 check energy transport expressed with E, B and the Poynting vector.
claims.unverified_vms_specific_step: Neither checks the specific VMS transport current under sources or its claimed source-dependent exterior-form balance law.
claims.interpretation: The related blocks cannot establish the full source claim solely by passing.
